subject: Web Development
title: The Plugin Explosion
description: A fast breakdown of The Plugin Explosion for builders.

hook.text: jQuery's real power wasn't the core library. It was the thousands of plugins.

buildup.text: Image sliders, date pickers, modal windows — there was a jQuery plugin for everything.

discovery.text: Developers could build complex websites by assembling plugins like building blocks.

twist.text: Plugin quality varied wildly. Many were abandoned, insecure, or conflicted with each other.

climax.text: The plugin ecosystem was the first glimpse of JavaScript's dependency culture.

punchline.text: Plugins made everything easy — and fragile.

quiz.question: What was the main risk of jQuery plugins?
